trust.title: Research must match the format
trust.description: An oral study and a topical patch test answer different questions. Our research guide shows what each kind of evidence can tell us.
trust.statementTitle: Evidence should match the product you use.
trust.statementBody: Studies of oral berberine do not prove the same absorption or outcomes for a topical patch. Finished-product studies would be needed for product-specific claims.
trust.oneBody: Luvlae Berberine Patches come in a convenient 60-count format.
trust.twoBody: Oral, preclinical transdermal, and finished-product evidence are different categories and should not be treated as interchangeable.
trust.threeBody: Skin sensitivity, medications, pregnancy, and individual health circumstances can matter. Ask a clinician when appropriate.

evidence.title: Research should match the product
evidence.description: Most human berberine studies examine oral products. Experimental topical studies use other formulations. Neither establishes absorption or health outcomes for Luvlae Berberine Patches, and no Luvlae-specific human clinical study has been supplied.
evidence.noteBody: Explore our ingredient, safety, and science guides for helpful product information.

faq.oneQuestion: How many patches are in a box?
faq.oneAnswer: Each box includes 60 Luvlae Berberine Patches.
faq.twoQuestion: Which ingredients are in the patches?
faq.twoAnswer: Visit our Ingredients page to explore the ingredients and per-patch amounts.
faq.threeQuestion: How long should I wear a patch?
faq.threeAnswer: Follow the directions included with your patches for wear and replacement guidance.
faq.fourQuestion: Do oral berberine studies show that these patches work?
faq.fourAnswer: No. Studies of products taken by mouth do not establish absorption or outcomes for a topical patch. See the science guide for the evidence by route.
